What Is LeafBlaster Pro by Gutterglove?

LeafBlaster Pro is Gutterglove's contractor-installed gutter guard line. It isn't sold for DIY installation, and Alex recommends the version that fits your trees and roof after seeing them in person.

🍂

Stainless Steel Micro-Mesh

Gutterglove describes this as the version most homes end up with: stainless steel mesh on hardened aluminum rails, suited to regular rainfall, some trees, and humid or coastal air.

🌲

Frame-Reinforced Micro-Mesh

A continuous hardened aluminum frame supports the mesh for homes under mature trees or that see heavy branches and snow loads.

🏠

All-Aluminum

Gutterglove positions this option for milder conditions with moderate debris. Alex will tell you honestly if it's the better fit.

How the Free On-Site Inspection Works

Guards only work as well as the gutters underneath them, so every quote starts with a look at your actual roofline.

1

Gutter & Roof-Edge Check

Alex checks gutter condition, pitch, hangers, seams, fascia, and downspouts, and notes the trees and debris around your home.

2

Honest Recommendation

You'll hear whether cleaning, repair, replacement, or gutter guards make the most sense. Cleaning alone is always an option.

3

Written Price

You get a written price for the work and the LeafBlaster Pro version recommended. No pressure and no obligation.

Installed on Suitable Existing Gutters

Your gutters don't have to be replaced automatically. LeafBlaster Pro is fitted to existing gutters that are in sound condition. If a run is sagging, leaking, pulling away, or damaged, Alex will explain what needs gutter repair or gutter replacement first. Installation time depends on the size and layout of the job.

See real installs by our own crew: before & after on a local roof, South Jersey installs, West Deptford, NJ project, and recent gutter guard projects.

Maintenance: Lower, Not Zero

No gutter guard is maintenance-free. Micro-mesh keeps leaves and needles out of the gutter, but plan on occasional checks from the ground and light cleaning of the mesh surface if pollen, seed pods, or fine debris build up, especially under heavy tree cover.

40-YEAR LIMITED PARTS WARRANTY

LeafBlaster Pro comes with Gutterglove's written warranty. Alex walks you through the terms before work begins.

  • 40 years on parts; 10 years in coastal areas within 5 miles of an ocean, gulf, sea, or lake.
  • Gutterglove chooses whether to repair or replace a covered part. Labor, hardware, and shipping aren't covered.
  • Transferable when you keep the warranty document and original receipt. Claims must be made within 90 days.
  • Requires professional installation. Exclusions include storm or hail damage, sap, moss, contact with copper, improper maintenance, and damaged gutters.

Gutter Guard Questions

What happens during the free on-site inspection?

Alex checks your gutters, roof edge, fascia, pitch and downspouts, looks at the trees around the house, and explains whether cleaning, repair, replacement or gutter guards make sense. You get a written price with no obligation.

Do I need new gutters to get LeafBlaster Pro?

Not automatically. LeafBlaster Pro is fitted to existing gutters that are in sound condition. If a section is loose, sagging, leaking or damaged, Alex will tell you what needs repair or replacement first.

Will gutter guards make my gutters maintenance-free?

No. Micro-mesh lowers maintenance but does not eliminate it. Plan on occasional checks from the ground and light cleaning of the mesh surface if debris, pollen or seed pods build up.

What warranty comes with LeafBlaster Pro?

Gutterglove provides a written 40-year limited parts warranty (10 years in coastal areas within 5 miles of an ocean, gulf, sea or lake). It covers parts, not labor, hardware or shipping, has exclusions, and is transferable when the owner keeps the warranty document and receipt. Alex reviews the written terms with you before work begins.
